repository.purpose: Develop and maintain SYMB-FER, a user-controlled protocol for transferring structured context and relational posture across stateless AI sessions.
repository.audience: Users, builders, maintainers, parser authors, and human or AI collaborators working with SYMB-FER tokens and runtime tooling.
repository.status: Active protocol; Token Track v6.2 is current, while the Runtime IDE Track is separately versioned at v4.0.
